---
description: Review a change against its acceptance criteria without modifying it.
agent: CATES SDLC
---

Review the user's specified diff and acceptance contract read-only.
Check correctness, regression coverage, public API/CLI/service compatibility,
security, rule/catalog/doc consistency and token-efficient agent behavior.
Report only actionable findings with file/line evidence, impact and a suggested
fix. Distinguish defects from preferences and disclose untested assumptions.
Do not edit files, post reviews or approve the PR. Independent human approval
remains required; this review is evidence, not permission to merge.
